project.summary: SGME memory engine bridge for DeepSeek Harness — multi-agent shared long-term memory with LLM distillation, scenario injection and proactive care signals, via HTTP.

release.changelog: Initial OMDSH submission: dsh-sgme 0.1.1 — automatic per-turn session capture (L0 append + async refine trigger), memory_search / wiki_search tools, proactive care signal tools (signal_pull/claim/ack), first-step persona injection.

management.label: DeepSeek Harness Profile Bundle (github:freehul/sgme git install wrapper)
management.instructions: Install via the DSH Profile Bundle mechanism with the exact pinned spec github:freehul/sgme#<commit>; the repo-root package.json is the git install wrapper whose dsh.bundle.patch points to adapters/dsh/sgme-bridge/cordis.patch.yml. Activation requires a profile restart.

declarations.permissions: HTTP(S) client to the SGME Gateway (:9910/:9913) for inject/search/append/refine-trigger and care-signal pull/claim/ack; no subprocess, no shell, no Python, no native code; credentials injected via environment variables (SGME_AGENT_KEY/SGME_ADMIN_KEY), never written into the repo; no install scripts.
declarations.testing: sgme-bridge suite: 65 vitest tests across 6 files (commands, sgme-client, tools, skeleton, session-sync) plus tsc typecheck clean (2026-08-16, verified during submission); runtime zero-Python by design (Node built-in fetch); failure isolation: every SGME call failure is logged and returns empty, never blocks the DSH main loop.

capability.invocation: invoke the model-facing tool memory_search with a natural-language query through the DSH ToolRuntime
capability.expected: a bounded structured result of tagged memory entries matching the query, or an empty list when none match

review.notes: Automatically prepared from #24; public fixed-source preflight passed. Human review is still required.
